name: rewind
note: wave7 (Rung-1 window, no-kickback + after-effect lane): P0 casts the REAL Shock at the Rager; P1 answers the WINDOW with the REAL Rewind ({2}{U}{U}, no unless-cost). At resolution Rewind counters the Shock (Rager lives) AND its Seq's second atom UNTAPS up to four lands — with only three tapped Plains seeded, the CHOOSE selector issues NO ask and untaps them all deterministically (an extra ask here would drain the one-word queue and CRASH the pack, so the empty decisions tail is itself a falsifier). P1 pays 2U+2 generic from six U (same-color-first) leaving {U:2}; P0 keeps {R:1} from Shock's own {R}.
